title: ICC rejects Duterte defense bid for expert verification of evidence

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III has rejected a request by former President Rodrigo Duterte’s lawyers to have all evidence from open sources verified by an expert, saying this could cause unnecessary delay to the start of his trial. In a decision dated Sept. 28, the chamber denied the defense’s request last month to amend the “E-Court Protocol,” the court’s electronic system, to require stricter authentication of evidence in Duterte’s crimes against humanity case. The defense, led by British barrister Peter Haynes, particularly asked the chamber to order the prosecution to add an “expert verification field” to […]...
